research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01. Confirmed private legal partnership, but complete employer timeline and full-time status remain unresolved. Public experience cannot be set to zero from omission in short biographies.

ABR dates are entity/GST events only. The continuing ABN until 2024 is not proof Pasin continued practising after entering Parliament; GST cancellation in 2013 is not a personal employment end date. A third-party 2016 interests index attributes drawings to spouse, not member; do not turn spouse income into his employment.

Adelaide employer, earlier Mount Gambier practice/predecessor, partnership commencement, legal-practice working hours, breaks and campaign-related leave require further primary evidence. Preserve year precision of official 2000–2013 span and reconcile component overlap before any duration calculation.
Childhood shop/farm assistance is documented without assuming payment, employment status or full-time years. Law/economics degrees and practical legal training are education, not paid work.

Searched official and party biographies, maiden speech, ABR history, contemporaneous ABC candidate guide, Mount Gambier annual report, law-firm/early-career/full-time queries and public LinkedIn profile. No earlier employer or full-time evidence found. APH direct biography restricted; indexed biography recovered. First-speech Parlinfo click returned Internal Error; reproduced Hansard read. LinkedIn profile returned Internal Error. No source restriction bypassed.

Follow-up: historical Law Society directories and original practice biographies/court appearances to identify Adelaide and pre-2009 employers; verify individual hours/leave and partnership dates. Recheck primary declared interests only for member’s own subsequent employment, not family finances.

First-person House account narrows professional sequence to Adelaide commercial law then Mount Gambier criminal law. Employer-specific/court/Law Society queries did not identify pre2009firms or establish full-time status/leave. FWA2011case and2010Gazette name practice only, not a new personal start date.
